# bare-js evaluator cases. A case starts with `=== name`. The source runs as one sloppy script.
# The result is the completion value. `// @limit` expects an execution limit (Node: a timeout).
# Every case is a tiny independent program; Node (vm, empty context) is the oracle.
=== arith
1 + 2 * 3 - 4 / 2 % 3
=== precedence_exp
2 ** 3 ** 2
=== exp_corner
String(1 ** Infinity) + "," + String((-1) ** Infinity) + "," + String(2 ** -1) + "," + String(NaN ** 0)
=== mod_neg
String(-7 % 3) + "," + String(7 % -3) + "," + String(1 / (-1 % 1)) + "," + String(5 % 0)
=== shifts

=== int32_wrap

=== string_concat
"a" + 1 + 2 + (1 + 2) + null + undefined + true
=== add_coerce

=== numeric_strings

=== to_string_numbers

=== loose_equality
[null == undefined, null == 0, "1" == 1, true == 1, "" == 0, "a" == "a", [] == "", [1] == 1, NaN == NaN, ({}) == "[object Object]"].join()
=== strict_equality

=== relational

=== typeof_all

=== void_comma

=== short_circuit_and

=== logical_values

=== logical_assign

=== logical_assign_short
